name: Frances Folsom Cleveland
mentions: …rise up long enough to ask whether, in spite of senator Edmunds and the vigilance of the reporters, president Cleveland has not committed bigamy. We have a collection of newspaper pictures of Mrs. Cleveland, ranging all the way from Bismarck with his mustache cut off and old Mother Bendor…

The Minneapolis exposition was opened Monday and the machinery was put in motion by Mrs. Grover Cleveland pressing a telegraph key at Upper Saranac lake in New York state. Everything points to a complete success for the expositson.
